title: chore(deps): move @objectstack/* to 18.0.0-next.1 and follow its contract (objectui#12370)
body:
Fixes #12370
Clause-②: yes — next.1 narrows `@object-ui/types` accept sets that parse through the spec's own page action rows and view data schema; the table under "Clause-② accept-set moves" lists each, with a parse that flips (next.0 ACCEPT, next.1 REJECT) on both public faces.
Fixes #12338

**Scope: move objectui's `@objectstack/*` from `18.0.0-next.0` to `18.0.0-next.1` and follow its contract, by the method objectui#12030 used (measure, then follow).** The six held follow-ups that wait on this release (objectui#12326, objectui#12294, objectui#12335, objectui#12349, objectui#12329, objectui#12195) are not done here; only #12338's row rides, as its card directs.

## What this does

- `npm view @objectstack/spec@next version` answers `18.0.0-next.1` (dist-tags `next: 18.0.0-next.1`, `latest: 17.7.0`); the release tag `@objectstack/cli@18.0.0-next.1` peels to objectstack `0c52e43075`.
- Every `@objectstack/*` range moves from `^18.0.0-next.0` to `^18.0.0-next.1`, uniformly as objectui#12030 did: 40 ranges in 32 manifests, edited textually; `pnpm-lock.yaml` regenerated by `pnpm install` only (99 `18.0.0-next.1` keys, 0 `next.0` left). `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` exits 0 afterwards.
- `main` merged twice (`8992522`, after objectui#12371 landed as `0a19a68`; `94b542a`, after `d78e70b`). Neither merge touched a manifest or the lockfile.

## The break list (measured on next.1, control on next.0)

Full suite in four lock-held quarters (`pnpm exec vitest run --shard=K/4`), on the heads named: shard 1 at `bd55fee` 2 files red / 1261 passed; shard 2 at `8992522` 4 / 1256; shard 3 at `272a269` 1 / 1263; shard 4 at `08331ae` 3 / 1260. Negative control: the nine red files as they stand on `main` `2d8450e`, installed `18.0.0-next.0`, run under the same lock: `Test Files 9 passed (9)`, `Tests 505 passed (505)`. After the fixes, the same files plus the ones touched since, on `76afe66` (next.1): `Test Files 12 passed (12)`, `Tests 571 passed (571)`.

| red site | upstream commit / PR | how it is closed |
|---|---|---|
| `packages/types/src/__tests__/held-public-block-arms-10872.test.ts` — the flat-onSuccess remedy row (#12338) | `1623fafc` (objectstack#23331): a page action row's `onSuccess` is refused beside a built-in other than api / script, and beside no executor | fixed here: the row names `actionType: 'api'` with a `target`, as the card prescribes |
| same file — "the bag IS the spec row", four action arms | `4d1e4a80` (objectstack#23164): the row's `onSuccess` is `ActionSchema`'s own block, whose `openIn` carries `.default('self')` | fixed here: the import boundary (objectui#8317) now strips that default, so the arm holds the bounded row; the pin compares against `stripImportedDefaults(row)` (memoised) and asserts the rebuild happens only on the four action rows |
| `packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/gridDataInputContract.test.ts` — four providers parse | `1912af47` (objectstack#23160): the view-level `api` data source is retired | fixed here: three providers parse, `api` is refused (its readers already left with objectui#12325) |

`pnpm build` (turbo, all but the site) 43/43 and `pnpm type-check` 81/81 on `76afe66`; after the second merge, `type-check` of app-shell and plugin-grid 31/31 and the ten test files that merge brought 177/177 on `94b542a`.

## Clause-② accept-set moves (`@object-ui/types`)

Measured through `safeValidateSchema` (tolerant) and `StrictAnyComponentSchema` (strict), same documents, `main` tree on next.0 vs this branch on next.1 (`tsx` probe over `packages/types/src/zod/index.zod.ts`). Every row reads the same on both faces.

| document (`properties` shown) | next.0 | next.1 | upstream |
|---|---|---|---|
| `action:button` / `action:icon` with `onSuccess` and no executor | ACCEPT | REJECT `custom` at `properties.onSuccess` | `1623fafc` |
| `action:button` with `actionType` `url`, `modal` or `flow` and `onSuccess` | ACCEPT | REJECT `custom` at `properties.onSuccess` | `1623fafc` |
| `action:group` member `type: 'url'` with `onSuccess` | ACCEPT | REJECT `custom` at `properties.actions.0.onSuccess` | `1623fafc` |
| `action:button` with `actionType: 'navigation'` | ACCEPT | REJECT `custom` at `properties.actionType` | `4d1e4a80` |
| `action:group` member `type: 'navigation'` | ACCEPT | REJECT `custom` at `properties.actions.0.type` | `4d1e4a80` |
| `action:button` `onSuccess` with a key besides `navigate` / `openIn` | ACCEPT | REJECT `unrecognized_keys` at `properties.onSuccess` | `4d1e4a80` |
| `action:button` `operation: 'update'` with `onSuccess` | ACCEPT | REJECT `custom` at `properties.onSuccess` | `775ed65e` |
| `action:button` `name: 'url'`, `target: 'tasks list'` | ACCEPT | REJECT `custom` at `properties.target` | `b529a5c2` |
| `object-grid` `data: { provider: 'api', read }` | ACCEPT | REJECT `invalid_union` at `properties.data.provider` | `1912af47` |
| `page` (or a page-kind node) with `kind: 'slotted'` and `slots.details: [{ type: 'object-grid', properties: { objectName: 'task', data: { provider: 'api', read: { url: '/api/rows' } } } }]` | ACCEPT | REJECT `custom` at `slots.details.0.properties.data.provider` (the spec's own message) | `05ab9ef8` (objectstack#23419, `checkPageComponentViewData`) |

Added in the patch round (`d9eb32a`). The `checkPageComponentViewData` row was measured through `PageNodeSchema` and `safeValidateSchema`. The same document with `data: { provider: 'object', object: 'task' }` stays ACCEPT on both versions, and the spec's `PageSchema` gives the same verdicts. A region child with the `api` provider already flips through the `object-grid` row above. `PageNodeSchema` / `PageKindNodeSchema` attach the check by the spec's own export, as they attach the other page checks.

Controls that stay ACCEPT on both: `actionType: 'api'` + `target` + `onSuccess`; a host handler (`actionType: 'run'`) or a bare `name` with `onSuccess`; `actionType: 'url'` without `onSuccess`; `operation: 'update'` without `onSuccess`; an `action:menu` member `type: 'api'` with `onSuccess`; `object-grid` `data: { provider: 'object' }`.

Exports: none added or removed. `ViewDataSchema` (exported) becomes reference-equal to the spec's object, since next.1 leaves it nothing to strip; its accept set is the row above.

## Changeset

`.changeset/pre.json` is absent on `main` (objectui#12334 has not landed), so no prerelease mode is in play. `.changeset/12370-spec-next-1.md` declares the 22 packages objectui#12030 declared, plus the console and runner bundles, all `minor` (never `major`), stating the range move and the accept-set narrowing above; it rides the next release with objectui#12030's entries. Two clauses in objectui#12030's pending changesets that name `next.0` as the floor now say `next.1`. `check-changeset-presence` ✅, `check-changeset-no-major` ✅, `check:changeset-claims` ✅, `check:pending-changeset-literals` ✅.

## Gates (exit codes, `76afe66` unless noted)

`pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` 0 · build 0 (43/43) · type-check 0 (81/81) · full suite: four quarters as above, red sites all closed and re-run green · `check:phantom-deps` 0 · `check:self-import` 0 · `check:unreferenced-sources` 0 · `check:doc-example-readers` 0 · `check:handler-key-reads` 0 · `check:side-effects-array` 0 · `check:element-data-source-declaration` 0 · `check:spec-symbols` 0 · `check:action-forward-parity` 0 · `check:designer-field-key-parity` 0 · `check:icon-record-names` 0 · `check:i18n-keys` 0 · `check:i18n-drift` 0 · `check:i18n-designer-parity` 0 · `check:installed-pin-claims` 0 (at `94b542a` too) · `check:lockfile-integrity` 0 · `check:control-bytes` 0 · `node scripts/check-changeset-fixed.mjs` 0.

- `check:spec-floors` exits 1 with "The scan collapsed: 0 package(s) declare @objectstack/spec in a consumer-facing field" on this branch and, identically, on `main` `2d8450e`: the bump does not change it (objectui#12334 owns it).
- Lint: not run repo-wide (CI owns `pnpm lint`). Narrowed and measured: `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` over the 34 changed `.ts` / `.tsx` / `.mjs` files reports 34 files, 0 errors; `eslint.config.js` sets no `parserOptions.project` / `projectService`, so linting is not type-aware and this diff cannot move a verdict on an untouched file.

## Acceptance notes

- objectui#12371 landed before this push; `flowValueSlots-12101.test.tsx` runs green on next.1 (in the 12-file re-run): no verdict change.
- `packages/core/src/utils/normalize-list-view.ts:430` (and its test at `:401`) and the `object-tree` `data` description in `packages/types/src/zod/objectql.zod.ts:2795` still say the view `data` slot has four providers / names the `api` provider. Prose only; nothing reads it. Left as is.
- The full suite ran across four heads, because the fixes landed while it ran; each later commit touched only the files re-run in the targeted run.
